Czech Footprint

Series

The Czech Republic was celebrating the centenary of Czech statehood in 2018. Škoda Storyboard is marking this occasion with a series of articles entitled Czech Footprints. This series traces Czech influences that have achieved world renown, some of which are not widely known to have roots in the Czech Republic.
